lines.zh: 我贴着暗水横着切过去。
lines.en: I slice sideways through the dark water.

lines.zh: 斧刃一样的背划开冷水。
lines.en: My hatchet-shaped back parts the cold current.
I follow that small crimson shadow ahead.
The deeper I go, the brighter my edge glows.
One flick of my tail and I slip into the rocks.
I swim lightly, afraid of making the water ring.
Three ahead of me; I take the rear.

lines.zh: 没有光的地方我也认得路。
lines.en: I know the way even where no light reaches.

lines.zh: 我的身子薄得像一片刃。
lines.en: My body is thin as a single blade.
Cold water squeezes past my gills.
I circle the sunken log once.

lines.zh: 这条水道，我熟得闭眼也能游。
lines.en: I know every turn of this channel.
The shadow is above; I stay below it.
I hug the bottom and glide forward.

lines.zh: 我从水草根之间斜穿过去。
lines.en: I cut diagonally through the roots of the weeds.

lines.zh: 上面的光斜了，我跟着转。
lines.en: The light above tilts. I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，刃边一明一暗。
lines.en: I hover, my blade edge blinking on and off.

lines.zh: 没有东西吃，我就慢慢晃。
lines.en: Nothing to eat, so I drift in place.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，我数着气泡。
lines.en: It is too quiet; I count the bubbles.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过去，装作石头。
lines.en: I turn sideways and pretend to be stone.

lines.zh: 水下黑得正好，我不用躲。
lines.en: The dark down here suits me fine.

lines.zh: 远处一声落水，我立刻沉低。
lines.en: A splash far off; I sink lower at once.

lines.zh: 我的红边在水里像一小道火。
lines.en: My red edge looks like a small fire.

lines.zh: 一动不动，别人才看不见我。
lines.en: If I stay still, no one sees me.

lines.zh: 有只鳕鱼路过，我没理它。
lines.en: A cod passed by; I ignored it.

lines.zh: 我悬在岩壁旁边歇一会。
lines.en: I rest beside the rock wall a while.

lines.zh: 水面亮得刺眼，我留在下面。
lines.en: The surface glare is harsh; I stay below.

lines.zh: 我在等一小块骨粉沉下来。
lines.en: I wait for a bit of bone meal to sink.

lines.zh: 尾巴自己摆了一下，没事。
lines.en: My tail moved by itself; never mind.
I am used to this cold water.
That one up there has moving flippers.
Looking for fish? I am right here.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，刃背竖起来。
lines.en: I tilt up; my blade back rises.
Do not put your hand in dark water.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到我边上了。
lines.en: Your torch reaches the edge of me.
I know buckets; you hold none.
Your feet are stirring up my water.
I stare and slowly back away.
Have you come to scoop me up?
Your boots are loud in the water.
A corner of my blade edge is gone.
Do not hit me; I have two hearts.
I tipped over and cannot get upright.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我半边身子木了。
lines.en: One hit and half my body goes numb.
I am too small to take a hit.

lines.zh: 泥水翻起来，我找不到方向。
lines.en: Mud swirls up; I cannot find my way.
Is that my schoolmate's blood?
I try to squeeze into the crevice.
It hurts; I keep quiet anyway.
You broke my glowing edge.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑往下沉，我跟过去。
lines.en: Those crumbs are sinking; I follow them.
Is that the smell of raw fish?

lines.zh: 你的灯太亮了，我却想靠近。
lines.en: Your lamp is too bright, yet I drift closer.

lines.zh: 骨粉撒下来，我绕了一圈。
lines.en: Bone meal sprinkles down; I circle once.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面晃，我上去看看。
lines.en: Something wavers at the surface; I rise.
I should not be this greedy.
What hangs beneath that line?
I smell the water inside your bucket.

lines.zh: 再靠近一寸，我就能碰到。
lines.en: One inch closer and I can touch it.

lines.zh: 你晃的东西让我忘了躲。
lines.en: That dangling thing made me forget to hide.

lines.zh: 撞上岩壁，我的刃边嗡了一下。
lines.en: I hit the rock wall; my blade edge rings.
Who pushed me in the water?
My schoolmates and I squash together.
Your boot kicked right into me.
My tail struck the sunken log; it hurts.
The current pins me against a stone.
Do not shove that bucket mouth at me.

lines.zh: 我被撞得横过来，翻了一圈。
lines.en: I was knocked sideways and rolled over.
I am too thin; any touch tilts me.
Something is pressing down from above.

lines.zh: 那条红边比我亮，我跟它走。
lines.en: That red edge is brighter; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，刃背对着刃背。
lines.en: We swim side by side, blade to blade.

lines.zh: 水里两小片红，靠在一起。
lines.en: Two small red patches, close together.

lines.zh: 它摆尾的节奏和我一样。
lines.en: Its tail keeps time with mine.
I want to be nearer, just a little.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一块石头，靠得很近。
lines.en: We circle the same stone, close together.
Its gill edge brushed along my fin.
Two shadows become one shadow.
I follow it without asking where.

lines.zh: 这样并着游，水就不冷了。
lines.en: Swimming like this, the water feels less cold.
A bit of bone meal fell into my mouth.
I catch that floating scale.
The crumbs on the bottom are mine.
I touched it once with my lips.

lines.zh: 这个不能吃，我还是含一会。
lines.en: Not edible, but I will hold it a while.
Something is stuck between the stones.
I nudge it to my mouth and swallow.

lines.zh: 水里的碎末，我一片片捡。
lines.en: I pick up the floating specks one by one.
That is yours; I know.
The piece in my mouth is still unswallowed.
That red speck ahead is one of mine.

lines.zh: 水面裂开一圈，有东西下来。
lines.en: The surface splits; something comes down.

lines.zh: 我听见骨头碰石头的声音。
lines.en: I hear bone knocking against stone.
That large shadow has turned away.

lines.zh: 有东西在装死，我看得见。
lines.en: Something plays dead; I can see it.

lines.zh: 碎屑落下的方向，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember where the crumbs fell.
It comes at me; I move first.
Something moves inside the rock crevice.
The one above has stopped moving.
I have fixed on that lamp.
I flatten myself and slide closer.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，我绕到后面。
lines.en: It has not seen me; I go behind.
I keep following that red glimmer.
When the water ripples, I chase.
I clamp my mouth on your bucket rim.
It backs off; I advance a little.
My blade edge is aimed at it.
At the stone I pause for a moment.
I swim along its tail.
Do not circle; I can keep up.
I ram it with the back of my blade.
One bite, and my teeth are barely there.
This hardly counts as a push.

lines.zh: 我照着它的鳃边蹭过去。
lines.en: I rub past the edge of its gills.
Do not blame me; you squeezed first.
I whipped it once with my tail.
Too weak; it did not even move.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松开，怕崩了牙。
lines.en: I bite, then let go, afraid of breaking teeth.
That bump flipped me over too.
I can only butt against hard things.
I open my eyes at the dark bottom.
The light is weak here; perfect.

lines.zh: 出生时，三条同伴围着我。
lines.en: At birth, three schoolmates surrounded me.
No sun on the surface; good.
Under the stone layer, the water is cold.

lines.zh: 我是从刷怪蛋里出来的。
lines.en: I came out of a spawn egg.
The first thing is to find my school.

lines.zh: 这口水潭太浅，我往下走。
lines.en: This pool is shallow; I go deeper.

lines.zh: 我出生在见不到光的地方。
lines.en: I was born where no light reaches.
Four small blades scatter together.

lines.zh: 热水烫得我刃边卷起来。
lines.en: The hot water curls my blade edge.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，我只会拍尾巴。
lines.en: On land I can only slap my tail.

lines.zh: 上了岸，我的鳃黏成一团。
lines.en: On land, my gills clump together.
The water burst; I was thrown over.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过我薄薄的身子。
lines.en: An arrow went through my thin body.

lines.zh: 那道光让我边上的红灭了。
lines.en: That light put out the red along my edge.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到碎屑，我发软。
lines.en: Too long without crumbs; I feel soft.

lines.zh: 雷电劈进水里，我整条麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water; numbness spread.
The dark below swallowed me whole.
